> Plan ref **D1** · Story S-D #4587 · Epic #4582 (owner-approved plan, 2026-11-01)

## Context / Business Value

In CI run 41330364793 Lisa's unit job ran as one job for 20.9 min, because Lisa's own `.github/workflows/ci.yml` does not set the `unit_test_shards` input that `quality.yml` already offers (#4479). Once the packed-host journey leaves the PR path (D3), the unit job is the longest required path. The epic's target is a Lisa PR CI critical path of 10 minutes or less.

## Technical Approach

- In `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, job `quality` (`uses: ./.github/workflows/quality.yml`), add `unit_test_shards: 4` under `with:`. Lisa's unit gate already runs Vitest through `lisa-test-run` (`test:cov:unit`), which is what `unit_test_shards` needs.
- Tune: if A2's timing artifacts exist when you implement this, pick the smallest shard count (2–20) whose slowest shard leg keeps the unit path within 8 minutes, using `node scripts/test-timing-report.mjs --run <recent run> --json`. Otherwise keep 4.
- Nothing else changes. `quality.yml` merges shard coverage and checks the thresholds once in the aggregate job, which keeps the required context `🔍 Quality Checks / 🧪 Run Unit Tests`, so branch protection needs no edit.
- This changes only Lisa's own caller workflow: no shipped file and no runtime behaviour. The `🧮 Plan Unit-Test Shards` and `🧪 Unit Tests shard i/N` legs appear as extra, non-required jobs.
- **Verify** on this PR's own CI run with `gh run view <run-id> -R CodySwannGT/lisa --json jobs --jq '.jobs[] | select(.name | test("Unit")) | {name, conclusion, startedAt, completedAt}'`. The merged-coverage threshold check in the aggregate is existing `quality.yml` behaviour, pinned by `tests/integration/quality-unit-test-shards.test.ts`. That test passing on this PR is the evidence for the coverage scenario; no deliberate coverage drop is needed.

## Acceptance Criteria

```gherkin
Scenario: The unit path takes at most 8 minutes
  Given .github/workflows/ci.yml passes unit_test_shards to quality.yml
  When a pull request's 🔍 CI Quality Checks run completes
  Then the time from the start of 🧮 Plan Unit-Test Shards to the completion of 🧪 Run Unit Tests is 8 minutes or less

Scenario: The required check still reports under its name
  When the run completes
  Then the check "🔍 Quality Checks / 🧪 Run Unit Tests" reports a conclusion on the PR
  And main's branch protection needs no change

Scenario: Coverage is still enforced once on the merged result
  Given a change that drops unit coverage below vitest.thresholds.json
  When the sharded run completes
  Then 🧪 Run Unit Tests fails
```

## Out of Scope

- Integration sharding (D2) and moving the packed-host journey (D3).
- Changing `quality.yml` or any host's workflow.

## Target Backend Environment

None — no runtime behavior change: config-only

CodySwannGT/lisa

- `gh issue list --repo CodySwannGT/lisa --search "unit_test_shards" --state all --limit 50`: 5 results. #4479 (closed) added the input and is linked. #4488 (closed) fixed Jest shard merging; Lisa uses Vitest. #4560 (closed) is the Rails equivalent.
